Most colocation is a commodity — We built this site with you in mind.

We have 20+ years in business and we are different than big box data centers. We work passionately to help partner with you for custom designed cages, racks, networking, and security needs.

Colocation, hosting, and cloud from one team, in one facility, on your terms.

Why choose OpenColo by American Cloud?
  • ✓
    Colo, hosting, and cloud under one roof
    Most providers force you to choose. We run all three from our own facility — one partner, one bill, zero finger-pointing.
  • ✓
    We own and operate the building
    Purpose-built in Santa Clara, run by the same team for 20+ years. Not a reseller, not a warehouse conversion — a real data center.
  • ✓
    Month-to-month contracts, always
    No multi-year lock-in. Scale up, scale down, or leave anytime. Your flexibility is not our bargaining chip.
  • ✓
    Our staff know you by name
    Every technician, engineer, and security guard is our employee — never outsourced. Sales and billing pick up the phone.
  • ✓
    Your network, your way
    Own BGP blend (AS18779), 50+ peered networks, carrier-neutral facility. Bring any provider or use ours.
  • ✓
    Enterprise infrastructure, boutique scale
    True 2N power, SOC 2 Type II, biometric security — the same specs as the mega-chains, without the corporate overhead.

Facility & infrastructure

Power, cooling, security, and compliance — built to keep you running.

Power and cooling
  • ✓
    Dual SVP utility feeds
    Silicon Valley Power — best reliability in California, lower cost than PG&E

    Dual 2750kW / 3437kVA generators

    Busway power delivery

    9MW capacity, 4.5MW expansion underway
    Room to grow for high-density deployments
  • ✓
    N+1 indirect evaporative cooling
    4x Vertiv IDEC units with hard-walled hot-aisle containment

  • ✓
    SOC 2 Type II certified
    Annual third-party audit of security controls
  • ✓
    ISO standards adherence
    Operational excellence, maximum security, and consistent service delivery
  • ✓
    Biometric access control
    Multi-factor authentication at every access point

    Secured site access with perimeter fence and key card entry

    In-house security personnel — never outsourced

    CCTV and man traps
    Complete video surveillance with physical intrusion prevention
  • ✓
    VESDA fire detection
    Very Early Smoke Detection with dual interlock pre-action dry pipe
  • ✓
    Seismic and flood resilience
    1.5 lp seismic rating, above 100-year floodplain, raised access flooring

  • ✓
    71,000 sq ft purpose-built facility
    Individual racks, cabinets, and custom cage buildouts available
  • ✓
    DCIM and BMS monitoring
    24/7 data center infrastructure management and building monitoring systems

    Loading dock with hydraulic lift
    Purpose-built for receiving heavy equipment — no residential elevators
  • ✓
    Raised access flooring
    Optimized airflow management and cable routing
  • ✓
    Secured storage
    Dedicated storage space available onsite
  • ✓
    N-Light LED lighting with motion sensing
    Energy-efficient lighting controls for lower operating costs

Built for people, not just servers

Your team will spend time here. We made sure it's worth it.

Onsite experience
  • ✓
    10 minutes from SJC airport
    Fly in, drive over, be hands-on with your gear the same day
  • ✓
    Onsite offices and conference rooms
    Lease dedicated workspace steps from your racks
  • ✓
    Customer work areas and lounge
    Comfortable indoor and outdoor spaces for long deployment days
  • ✓
    Onsite parking and WiFi
    Free parking, facility-wide WiFi — no guest passes or garage fees
  • ✓
    Free basic remote hands
    Onsite technicians handle routine tasks at no charge
  • ✓
    Dedicated sales and billing teams
    Reach a real person by phone or email — no chatbots, no ticket queues

Where it fits best

Common workloads that thrive in a facility like ours.

  • ✓
    Hybrid cloud without the complexity
    Private racks in your cage, burst to AWS/GCP/Azure through direct on-ramps — managed by one team
  • ✓
    High-density AI and GPU clusters
    9MW capacity with flexible power configurations for racks that need 30kW+
  • ✓
    Bay Area low-latency applications
    10 min from SJC, dark fiber to Equinix and CoreSite — for when milliseconds matter
  • ✓
    Disaster recovery that doesn’t share your risks
    Purpose-built, seismic-rated, above 100-year floodplain — a secondary site that actually is secondary
  • ✓
    Compliance-first deployments
    SOC 2 Type II, physical security controls, dedicated cages — built for fintech, healthcare, and government

From first call to go-live

Most deployments are up and running within weeks.

How it works
  • ○
    Talk to us
    Discuss your power, space, connectivity, and compliance needs
  • ○
    Tour the facility
    Walk the floor, inspect power and cooling, meet the operations team
  • ○
    Design your deployment
    Racks, cages, power, cross-connects — engineered together
  • ○
    Go live
    Loading dock, onsite techs, pre-provisioned connectivity, DCIM monitoring from day one

Migrating from another facility?

We make the move painless.

Why migrate?
  • ✓
    Lower power costs
    Silicon Valley Power delivers better rates and reliability than PG&E markets
  • ✓
    True 2N redundancy
    Upgrade from N+1 facilities to dual SVP feeds, dual 2750kW generators, and 4x UPS units
  • ✓
    Escape your contract
    Move in on month-to-month terms — no multi-year penalty to escape, no matching your current deal’s end date
  • ✓
    Carrier-neutral flexibility
    Bring any provider or use our blended BGP — no single-carrier lock-in
Migration support
  • ○
    Hands-on migration support
    Our technicians assist with racking, cabling, and power-on during migration
  • ○
    Purpose-built loading dock
    Hydraulic lift for receiving heavy equipment — no residential elevators
  • ○
    Pre-provisioned connectivity
    Cross-connects and carrier circuits ready before your hardware arrives
  • ○
    DCIM monitoring from day one
    Environmental monitoring active immediately — power, temperature, and humidity

Are you an EGIHosting customer?

Your services, invoices and support tickets are in the American Cloud billing portal.

OpenColo and EGIHosting are now part of American Cloud, so egihosting.com brings you to this page. AS18779, the EGIHosting network, is the blended BGP network OpenColo runs from this Santa Clara facility at 3223 Kenneth Street.

Where to find your account
  • ○
    Services, invoices and support tickets
    Log in at billing.americancloud.com, then open Support and Support Tickets. Support moved there from livesupport.egihosting.com, so you don’t need a separate support login.
  • ○
    No billing portal login yet?
    Email [email protected] and we’ll set one up.

Tell us about your project and we'll get back to you shortly.
